ModMetaData.name: Touch Grass: Playtime Limiter
ModMetaData.author: Cynicus
ModMetaData.description: Touch Grass sets a limit on how long you play RimWorld. The session timer starts only once a colony is playable, so startup and save loading don't count against you. You can limit play by duration or by a real-world stop time, and the limit locks in once play begins. When time runs out, a decision window lets you take one to three five-minute snoozes. You can also restrict play to as many as three daily time windows. Set this session's limit from the main menu before you load a colony.
